name: Cilium Network Policy
description: Cilium eBPF 네트워크 정책과 Hubble 플로우 이벤트를 모니터링하는 마이크로세그멘테이션 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description_en: Cilium eBPF network-policy monitoring. Proxies Cilium agent health and policy APIs, and ingests Hubble flow events for in-memory analysis. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

endpoints.description: List active network policies from Cilium agent
Receive Hubble flow events (webhook, guard by CILIUM_WEBHOOK_ENABLED)
List stored Hubble flows with optional verdict/namespace filter

env_vars.name: CILIUM_AGENT_URL
env_vars.description: Cilium agent REST API base URL

env_vars.name: CILIUM_HUBBLE_MAX
env_vars.description: Maximum number of Hubble flows to keep in memory
